login_title: Sign in to the VPN panel
login_failed: Sign-in failed. Check your user name, password and code. After repeated failures the account is locked for a while.
session_expired: You were signed out after {minutes} minutes without activity. Sign in again.
csrf_failed: The form expired. Go back, reload the page and try again.
none_expiring: No account expires in the next 14 days.
cap_reached: All {max} user slots are in use ({used}). Delete a user to free a slot.
ctl_unreachable: Live connection data is not available: the gateway's management service is not responding.
username_hint: Lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; 2 to 64 characters. It cannot be changed later.
expiry_hint: At most {max} days from today. You can extend it later.
link_created_for: Send this link to {username}. It lets them set a password, add the authenticator and download the VPN profile.
link_once: The link works once and expires in {hours} hours. It is not shown again.
mail_sent: The link was also sent to {email}.
mail_failed: The e-mail could not be sent. Copy the link above and pass it on yourself.
reset_hint: Reset disconnects the user and creates a new setup link. The certificate stays the same.
delete_hint: Deleting revokes the certificate, disconnects the user and frees the slot. It cannot be undone; the audit log keeps the history.
delete_confirm_mismatch: The user name you typed does not match. Nothing was deleted.
bad_display_name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
bad_username: This user name is not allowed. Use lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore (2 to 64 characters).
cert_failed: The certificate could not be issued, so the user was not created. Ask DBO to check the gateway.
enroll_restart: This step has to be done in the same browser where you set the password. Start again from the link.
link_invalid: This setup link is not valid. It may have been used already or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
no_free_ip: No free VPN address is left. Ask DBO to check the gateway.
revoke_failed: The certificate could not be revoked, so the user was not deleted. Ask DBO to check the gateway.
totp_wrong: That code is not correct. Wait for a new code in the app and enter it.
user_exists: A user with this name already exists.
pw_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
pw_too_short: The password must be at least {min} characters long.
pw_is_username: The password cannot be your user name.
pw_rules: At least {min} characters. A short sentence you can remember works well.
enroll_step2: Step 2 of 3: add the account to your authenticator app
enroll_step3: Step 3 of 3: download your VPN profile
manual_entry: Scan the code with Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator or a similar app. It appears as {issuer}. If you cannot scan, enter this key by hand:
download_once: The download is available for 15 minutes in this browser only. Keep the file private.
download_gone: The profile download is no longer available. Ask your administrator to reset your account.
download_failed: The profile could not be created. Ask your administrator to contact DBO.
connect_1: Install OpenVPN Connect or the OpenVPN client for your device.
connect_3: Connect with the user name {username}, your password and the current code from your authenticator app.
admin_enroll_done: Your password and authenticator are set. Sign in with your user name, password and the code from the app.
slots_hint: Disabled and expired users keep their slot until they are deleted.
locked_explain: VPN login is locked until {time} after repeated wrong passwords or codes. Unlock only if you know the attempts were the user's own.
det_username_does_not_match_certificate: user name does not match the certificate
det_certificate_cn_is_not_a_gateway_user: certificate does not belong to a gateway user
det_unknown_disabled_or_not_enrolled: unknown, disabled or setup not completed
det_fixed_address_outside_the_vpn_subnet: fixed VPN address outside the VPN subnet
cert_renew_failed: A new certificate could not be issued. Ask DBO to check the gateway.
cert_short: ends before the last valid day: reset the user to issue a new certificate
cert_renewed_on_download: a new certificate is issued when the user downloads the profile
act_cert_renew_failed: New certificate could not be issued
act_cert_info_failed: Certificate state could not be read
cert_renew_busy: A new certificate is being issued for this account right now. Wait a few seconds and download again.
dtl_user_created: profile: {profile}, VPN IP: {ip}, last valid day: {expires_on}, e-mail: {email}
